settings.title: What is this for?
settings.content: This applicator is intended for skincare professionals and individuals using the MyoLift MD device to perform microcurrent facial treatments. It aids in muscle re-education and skin rejuvenation by transmitting microcurrent to specific facial areas.

settings.title: What is included?
settings.content: • One MyoLift MD Classic Applicator with dual probes.

settings.title: How To Use
settings.content:
1. Connect: Attach the dual probes of the Classic Applicator to the MyoLift MD device.
  2. Apply Conductive Gel: Apply a suitable conductive gel to the treatment area to ensure proper conductivity.
  3. Treatment: Use the applicator to deliver microcurrent to the desired facial areas, following the recommended techniques and protocols provided by 7E Wellness.

settings.title: Benefits
settings.content:
• Enhanced Facial Toning: Assists in lifting and firming facial muscles through microcurrent therapy.
  • Improved Skin Appearance: Regular use can lead to smoother, more youthful-looking skin.
  • User-Friendly: Designed for ease of use, making it accessible for both professionals and individuals familiar with microcurrent treatments.

settings.title: Product Features
settings.content:
• Dual-Probe Design: Allows for precise application of microcurrent to targeted facial muscles.
  • Compatibility: Specifically designed for use with the MyoLift MD device.
  • Professional-Grade: Suitable for both professional and at-home use by trained individuals
